description: Summary figure: CACUL1 domain architecture, AlphaFold confidence, and Foldseek coverage of cullin chains
code:
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
iface=json.load(open('interface_residues.json'))
plddt=pd.read_csv('cacul1_plddt_per_residue.csv', index_col=0)['pLDDT']
df=pd.read_csv('foldseek_pdb100_hits.csv')

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(12.5,9.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,1,height_ratios=[1.25,0.85,1.1],hspace=0.55)

# --- A: domain architecture ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
tracks=[('CUL1 (Q13616)',776,
         [(21,518,'#90cdf4','cullin repeats PF00888'),(539,658,'#f6ad55','a+b domain PF26557'),(706,766,'#fc8181','neddylation WHB PF10557')]),
        ('CUL3 (Q13618)',768,
         [(34,484,'#90cdf4',''),(507,665,'#f6ad55',''),(698,760,'#fc8181','')]),
        ('CACUL1 (Q86Y37)',369,
         [(137,293,'#90cdf4','single cullin repeat PF00888')])]
for i,(name,L,feats) in enumerate(tracks):
    y=2-i
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0,y-0.16),L,0.32,fc='#e2e8f0',ec='#718096',lw=0.8))
    for a,b,c,lab in feats:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((a,y-0.16),b-a,0.32,fc=c,ec='#2d3748',lw=0.6))
        if lab: ax.text((a+b)/2,y+0.26,lab,ha='center',fontsize=7.5)
    ax.text(-20,y,name,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=9.5)
    ax.text(L+12,y,f'{L} aa',va='center',fontsize=8,color='#4a5568')
# feature marks
for p,_ in iface['CUL1_RBX1_contacts']:
    ax.plot([p],[2.22],marker='|',color='#2b6cb0',ms=5,mew=0.9)
ax.text(620,2.42,'62 RBX1-contact residues (1LDJ)',fontsize=7.5,color='#2b6cb0',ha='center')
ax.plot([720],[1.78],marker='v',color='#c53030',ms=7); ax.text(720,1.58,'K720 NEDD8',fontsize=7.5,color='#c53030',ha='center')
ax.plot([712],[0.78],marker='v',color='#c53030',ms=7); ax.text(712,0.58,'K712 NEDD8',fontsize=7.5,color='#c53030',ha='center')
for p,_ in iface['CUL3_BTB_contacts']:
    ax.plot([p],[1.22],marker='|',color='#2f855a',ms=5,mew=0.9)
ax.text(120,1.40,'23 BTB-adaptor contacts (4HXI)',fontsize=7.5,color='#2f855a')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((131,-0.16),107,0.32,fc='none',ec='#2f855a',lw=1.6,ls='--'))
ax.annotate('CACUL1 131-237 superposes on CUL3 27-132\n(100 CA pairs, RMSD 1.53 A, 25% id)',
            xy=(190,-0.2),xytext=(330,-0.62),fontsize=7.5,color='#2f855a',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='#2f855a',lw=0.9))
ax.set_xlim(-170,900); ax.set_ylim(-0.95,2.75); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel('residue')
for s in ['top','right','left']: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title('A  CACUL1 carries one cullin repeat and none of the catalytic scaffold modules',loc='left',fontsize=10.5)

# --- B: pLDDT ---
ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax2.plot(plddt.index,plddt.values,lw=1.1,color='#2b6cb0')
ax2.axhline(70,ls=':',color='#718096',lw=0.9)
ax2.axvspan(137,293,color='#90cdf4',alpha=0.35)
ax2.text(215,16,'PF00888 cullin repeat\nmean pLDDT 95.4',ha='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax2.text(65,16,'1-130 disordered\nmean pLDDT 42.4',ha='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax2.set_xlim(1,369); ax2.set_ylim(0,100); ax2.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax2.set_xlabel('CACUL1 residue')
ax2.set_title('B  AlphaFold model AF-Q86Y37-F1 v6: the only confidently folded module is the single cullin repeat',loc='left',fontsize=10.5)
for s in ['top','right']: ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- C: Foldseek coverage of full-length cullin chains ---
ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
cul=df[(df.dbLen>600)&(df['eval']<0.5)].copy()
cul['short']=cul.target.str.split('-assembly').str[0].str.upper()+' '+cul.target.str.extract(r'cif\.gz_(\S+)')[0]
cul=cul.sort_values('eval').head(20).iloc[::-1]
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(cul.iterrows()):
    ax3.plot([1,r.dbLen],[i,i],color='#cbd5e0',lw=4,solid_capstyle='butt')
    ax3.plot([r.dbStartPos,r.dbEndPos],[i,i],color='#2b6cb0',lw=4,solid_capstyle='butt')
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(cul))); ax3.set_yticklabels(cul.short,fontsize=6.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('residue position in the cullin chain of the PDB entry')
ax3.set_title('C  Foldseek search of the CACUL1 model against PDB100: alignment to cullins (blue) stops at ~residue 250 in every case',loc='left',fontsize=10.5)
ax3.axvline(250,ls='--',color='#c53030',lw=1)
ax3.text(258,len(cul)-1.5,'no match beyond ~250:\nno a+b domain, no RBX1 site,\nno neddylation WHB',fontsize=7.5,color='#c53030')
for s in ['top','right']: ax3.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
print('cullin hits plotted:',len(cul),' max dbEndPos among significant cullin hits:',cul.dbEndPos.max())
